schema_version: v0 — skill-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The resolution pivot: assert the points are wrapped → run the inward completeness check → cast the node (type it + bind its class's gates) → spawn children and/or reach an escalation → resolve (survivors file to CairnCommons). Casting lives here; there is no separate /ticket.
why: This is where open thinking becomes structure — the whole point of the resolver being spent on the novel and never on re-deriving the settled (Law 1). The inward completeness check is the second feedback loop (proof-on-close's front door): an incomplete node is caught before cost is spent building it. Casting binds workflow to node-class here, once, so the ticket artifact is workflow-neutral (everybody has tickets) and the node's state IS the pipeline instance (no orchestrator holds a second copy to drift).
invoke: /sorted  (when the points in hand feel wrapped and you're ready to resolve)
state: v0 — first cast 2026-07-15. A resolver-occupied nexus; the role-replacement staircase applies (intention extraction + decomposition are scaffolded here first).

nexus.note: SKILL.md carries the live sequence + question set; this is the charter-face record.
nexus.routes_forward: cast + filed → build under the bound gates → prove
nexus.routes_back: completeness red → design; can't resolve → an escalation (never a dead end)

casting.types: node-class charters in CairnCommons/node_classes/ (skill, concept-piece, code-seam, …); an absent class needed is a demand to write it
casting.variable: which gate / which check-type (proof gate / derivation gate / signature gate)
casting.the_watch: BY DEFAULT, CAST ONE (ratified 2026-07-30, ticket watchme-emits-a-probe). For a class whose version vocabulary carries WATCHME, casting answers 'how will we know this intention actually WORKED?' — either WATCHME(<object>) in the workflow string with its spec on the ticket — the five fields (trigger, enough, carrier, nexus, consumer) plus the probe berth path the emission gate resolves ARMED from — or "none, because X". Silence is not a legal answer — and since 2026-08-03 (ticket sorted-becomes-a-learning-block) it is checked AT THE CAST: the cast fires through the door (skills/sorted/door.py composing the skill_block seam), which refuses a missing spec field or an exemption reason with no resolvable referent, one pass, before the ticket files. The emission gate on the WATCHME crossing remains the downstream seat. UNSPECIFIABLE is a RED on the completeness gate (the falsifier is unwritable, so the node is not ready to cast); specifiable-but-not-yet DROPS A TICKET and carries the IOU. Optional to carry, mandatory to satisfy once carried.

input_contract.assumption_check: the completeness question 'any unstated assumption still load-bearing?' answered in substance — the named assumptions and their standing, or the explicit finding that none remain. A one-word pass is the hollow check this door exists to stop.
input_contract.missing_check: the completeness question 'any point asserted-wrapped that actually isn't?' answered in substance. Forced because the un-wrapped point cast anyway is the exact defect the gate was written against.
input_contract.falsifier_check: the node's stated falsifier and horizon — Law 3 at the cast: no falsifier, not ready to cast. This is the field whose absence used to route back silently in conversation.
input_contract.collision_check: the completeness question 'collides with an existing intention/Law/decision?' answered over the WHYS of each side (exclusive-and-terminal, or a distinction to record) — the congruency-lab consult made a recorded answer instead of a private glance.
input_contract.builder_check: the completeness question 'putting on the hat of Boris Cherny, what questions will a Haiku-level builder need answered which aren't?' answered in substance — the consumer-perspective adversarial check that catches gaps the caster knows implicitly but never wrote down. The existing checks (assumption_check, missing_check) are self-referential: the same mind that wrote the ticket judges its completeness. This forces a perspective shift to the cheapest possible builder, who cannot infer what the caster left implicit. Cocoon principle: push inference cost into casting where it's cheap, not the build step where it's expensive.
input_contract.node_class: the class being cast, resolvable in CairnCommons/node_classes/ — an unknown class is a demand to write one FIRST, not a value to improvise. The door checks resolution, not spelling.
input_contract.workflow: the full workflow string with its cursor, conforming to the class's registered version — a drifted string refused at cast costs one fix; the same string refused at first crossing costs a dead voyage.
input_contract.gates_bound: the class's gate-set transcribed onto this node (which proof gate, which check-type) — the binding /sorted exists to perform, recorded rather than implied.
input_contract.watchme: the spec the EMISSION GATE reads (cairn/tools/base/watchme_spec.py, one implementation — the door fires the gate's own watchme_spec_error): the object join key, the five fields (trigger, enough, carrier, nexus, consumer) AND the probe berth path, or 'none, because <X>' with a JUDGEABLE reason: one that carries a resolvable referent (a path, a cast ticket id, a roster command). Silence is not a legal answer; a plausible sentence pointing at nothing checkable is refused as the hollow pass it is. CORRECTED 2026-08-07: this sentence used to read '(object, trigger, enough, carrier, consumer — nexus welcome)' — a five-field list weaker than the gate, and the door compiled the weakness faithfully. Measured 2026-08-05, n=2 in one session: two casts fired clean through the door and the gate's corpus proof redded both minutes later for the missing probe berth (trouble the-sorted-door-checks-five-fields-and-the-gate-needs-six). A check is worth its mesh; the door now runs the gate's code, so this sentence and the enforcement cannot drift apart again.
input_contract.children: the child nodes this cast spawns (ids or first-cut names), or 'none, because <X>' — a decomposition that lived only in conversation is the partial cast that dies with the context.
input_contract.exit: routed_forward (the node is cast and files) or routed_out (this firing did not cast) — the seam's two exits, kept honest by `disposition`.
input_contract.disposition: the real route: 'cast' under routed_forward; 'not-ready' or 'escalated:<rung>' under routed_out — so the seam's two-exit vocabulary never flattens /sorted's three real outcomes.
input_contract.bullets: the exit-time finding — {text, stratum} list standing at Akien's gate, forced at BOTH exits: a cast refused or routed back with no record teaches nobody.

how_it_learns: By casts that later proved incomplete: when a node cast 'wrapped' but failed downstream, the miss becomes a gate-record and /sorted's completeness check gains the question that would have caught it. The specimen skill — it caught drift at the point of creation this session. Endpoint into cc-learning-store; interim by-hand.
traces_to: Law 1 (novel not settled — resolution becomes structure)
Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a real proof)
Law 3 (nothing known until measured — the completeness check)
